en: “tele” means far, as in telephone and television.
“graph” means write, as in autograph and paragraph.
“port” means carry, as in portable and transport.
“scope” means look at, as in telescope and microscope.
“phon” means sound, as in phone and microphone.
“micro” means very small, as in microscope.
“auto” means self, as in autograph, your own signature.
“chron” means time, as in chronological, in time order.
“aud” means hear, as in audio and audience.
“rupt” means break, as in erupt and interrupt.
“struct” means build, as in structure and construct.
“manu” means hand, as in manual, done by hand.
“astro” means star, as in astronaut and astronomy.
“dict” means say, as in dictionary and predict.
“photo” means light, as in photograph, made by light.
Which word contains a root meaning “far”?
“Tele” means far. A television shows pictures sent from far away.
Which word contains a root meaning “life”?
“Bio” means life. A biography is the story of someone’s life.
Which word contains a root meaning “carry”?
“Port” means carry. Transport carries people or goods.
Which word contains a root meaning “water”?
“Aqua” means water. An aquarium is a tank of water for fish.
Which word contains a root meaning “look at”?
“Scope” means look at. A microscope helps us look at tiny things.
Using its roots, what is a telescope?
a tool for seeing things far away
a tool for hearing quiet sounds
“Tele” means far and “scope” means look at.
Using its roots, what does a biologist study?
“Bio” means life and “logy” means the study of.
Using its roots, what is an autobiography?
the story of a person’s life, written by that person
the story of a person’s life, written by someone else
“Auto” means self, “bio” means life and “graph” means write.
What do the two roots in “microphone” mean?
“Micro” means small and “phon” means sound. A microphone picks up small sounds and makes them louder.
Using its roots, what is geology?
the study of the earth and its rocks
“Geo” means earth and “logy” means the study of.

en.title: Greek and Latin roots
en.teach: Many English words are built from old Greek and Latin parts called roots. Tele means far and phon means sound, so a telephone carries sound from far away.
